test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

No woman would be pleased if you said that she did not know the difference__ in good and bad__ dressing.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'between good and bad'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is **'between good and bad'. **
 
• The given sentence has an error of **'Preposition'.**
 
• So. replacing **'in good and bad'** with **'****between good and bad'** will make the sentence correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

**Correct sentence**__: *No woman would be pleased if you said that she did not know the difference **__between good and bad__ **dressing. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'into good and bad'** is not correct here.
 
• **'among good and bad'** is not correct here.
